curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8274-1-2.pdf and 8274-1-3.pdf (books 1/2 and 2/2 of the combine: functions on book 1 pages 2-3, combine steps 1-52, header steps 1-29); 8274-1-1.pdf and 8274-1-4.pdf build the alternate dragster (8274-2)

functions.does: The 20-tooth gear on top behind the cab steers the rear wheels: its shaft runs down to a knob gear that meshes with the knob gear on the 8-tooth pinions' shaft, which drive the rack between the rear wheels.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (curved arrows over the cab); book 1 step 32 (the 20-tooth gear on top); inferred: the gear train below, from the model

functions.does: The 20-tooth gear on top at the front raises and lowers the header: its shaft runs down to a knob gear, which turns a worm, which turns a 24-tooth gear that lifts the feeder holding the header.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (up arrows at the header); book 1 steps 3-5 (worm and 24-tooth gear) and 22 (the 20-tooth gear on top); inferred: how the 24-tooth gear lifts the feeder

functions.does: Pushing the combine along turns the header's reel: the front axle's differential turns a 24-tooth gear on a cross shaft, whose knob gear drives a shaft running forward through a universal joint to a knob gear at the front, which meshes with the header's knob gear; through two 24-tooth gears at the header's right end it turns the reel's red bars round, sweeping the crop down.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (curved arrows on the reel); book 1 steps 4-9 (differential, cross shaft, universal joint), book 2 header steps 19-29 and page 51

functions.does: The front wheels drive through a differential, so they can turn at different speeds in a bend: with the reel's drive held, turning one front wheel turns the other the opposite way.
functions.source: book: 1 step 4 (the differential on the front axle); inferred: what it's for

functions.does: The white unloading auger swings out from the grain tank to the side and back in along the body.
functions.source: book: 1 page 3 (curved arrow at the auger); book 2 steps 50-51 (the auger and its pivot)

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely; only the front pair drives anything.
For road travel the header comes off the front and is hitched behind the combine, where it rolls on its two small wheels at one end.
functions.source: book: 1 pages 2-3 (the header shown towed behind, the big white arrow), book 2 page 51
functions.note: a rebuild by hand, not a function of the assembled model; the small wheels are p1084 59895 and p1085 59895
